title: Python type check (mypy + pyright)
summary: Static type checking of the detected Python source dirs with mypy and pyright.
notes: Runs mypy and pyright over your detected Python dirs (net-new vs `agentsec audit`, which does security scanning, not type checking). Best-effort installs project deps (per-dir requirements.txt / a root pyproject) so imports resolve. Ships with mypy --ignore-missing-imports to avoid third-party-stub noise on the first run — remove it (and add types-* stubs / point --config-file at your own config) to tighten. Both checkers gate the build; make non-blocking during rollout by appending `|| true` to each.
